$comment: Curated opening-night snapshot for the Memphis Grizzlies, 2025-26. Drafted by the orchestrator from model knowledge; every row starts verified:false and must be confirmed by the repo owner against the cited sources before the MVP is called ready. person_id may be null here; derive resolves ids by name from the NBA player-movement feed and fails loudly if it cannot. Rows marked verified:true with a feed note were confirmed against the captured feed; the remaining players were on the roster before the feed window and still need owner confirmation.
